_comment: 夜间/空闲窗口任务队列（种子定义；运行状态写 night-tasks.state.json）

tasks.name: 原生1080p探测(1920×1088,无LoRA,5s)
tasks.exec: cd ~/videoGenerate-Model-zju && python3 runs/h3_submit.py --stage t2v --prompt "Cinematic aerial establishing shot of a futuristic cyberpunk city street at dawn, warm light, one continuous 5-second take, no text, no watermark" --seconds 5 --width 1920 --height 1088 --lora none --steps 20 --seed auto

tasks.name: Wav2Lip 口型冒烟(专题,需agent对话)
1080p×4x 终极档(t2v版,1920×1088 原生+4x→7680×4352, 单命令提交即等待)
tasks.exec: bash -lc 'cd ~/videoGenerate-Model-zju && ~/qwen-agent-venv/bin/python3 runs/h3_submit.py --stage t2v --prompt "A dim hospital room at night, an elderly mother lies dying in a hospital bed, IV drip and vital-sign monitor glowing, her middle-aged son in a pale green shirt sits at the bedside holding her hand, warm bedside lamp, window blinds with blurred city lights, soft ambient beeps and night-city hum, empathetic melancholy" --seconds 5 --width 1920 --height 1088 --lora none --steps 20 --upscale 4x > ~/nt_hd4x.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?'

tasks.name: 1080p×4x 终极档·参考图版(r2v+3张参考图→1920×1088→4x 7680×4352)
tasks.exec: bash -lc 'cd ~/videoGenerate-Model-zju && ~/qwen-agent-venv/bin/python3 runs/h3_submit.py --stage r2v --width 1920 --height 1088 --seconds 5 --lora ref2v_8step --image uploads/20260906/6718385e_母亲.png --image uploads/20260906/6f928fd2_父亲.png --image uploads/20260904/530faffd_父母卧室.png --prompt "A dim hospital room at night. <Picture 1> lies weak and dying in a hospital bed with IV drip and vital-sign monitor beside it, eyes closed, breathing shallow. <Picture 2> the father in a pale green shirt sits at the bedside, leaning forward, gazing at her with grief and sorrow, one hand resting on the blanket. The room matches <Picture 3>: warm bedside lamp, monitor glow, window blinds with blurred city lights at night. Soft sad ambient hospital beeps and faint night-city hum. The reference images (scene/character/props) are locked throughout the whole shot; they are NOT first-frame/last-frame keyframes; keep every frame consistent. masterpiece, best quality, realistic, cinematic lighting, emotional. No text, no watermark, no cuts, no dialogue." --upscale 4x > ~/nt_hd4x_r2v.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?'
